questions.cardText:
[Food Science] How is decaffeinated coffee decaffeinated?
A. By washing
B. By fermentation
C. By heating until caffeine evaporates
Answer: A. Coffee (and tea) are typically decaffeinated by “washing” them with chemical solvents like ethyl acetate or using supercritical carbon dioxide to extract caffeine while preserving flavor.
questions.de: Kaffee wird entkoffeiniert, indem man die Bohnen mit einem Lösungsmittel wie Ethylacetat „wäscht“ – welches Gas wird in überkritischem Zustand ebenfalls verwendet, um das Koffein herauszulösen?
questions.en: Coffee is decaffeinated by 'washing' the beans with a solvent such as ethyl acetate — which gas, in its supercritical state, is also used to extract the caffeine?

timeline.labelEn: Ludwig Roselius invents the first commercially successful process for decaffeinating coffee
timeline.labelDe: Ludwig Roselius erfindet das erste kommerziell erfolgreiche Verfahren zum Entkoffeinieren von Kaffee

questions.notes: The card's 'by washing' is vague; the open question asks the solvent named in its explanation. Supercritical CO2 decaffeination was developed by Kurt Zosel (Max Planck Institute); dichloromethane and water processes also exist.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the sun mostly made up of?
A. Helium B. Hydrogen C. Uranium
Answer: B. Over 70% of the Sun is composed of hydrogen, and most of the remainder is helium. These elements undergo nuclear fusion in the Sun’s core, producing vast amounts of energy that power the Sun and support life on Earth.
questions.de: Aus welchem chemischen Element besteht die Sonne größtenteils?
questions.en: Which chemical element makes up most of the Sun?

timeline.labelEn: Cecilia Payne's doctoral thesis shows that stars are made mostly of hydrogen and helium
timeline.labelDe: Cecilia Paynes Doktorarbeit zeigt, dass Sterne überwiegend aus Wasserstoff und Helium bestehen

questions.notes: About 73% of the photosphere's mass is hydrogen, ~25% helium.
